Daily oral TDF or 
daily oral TDF/
FTC or daily 
topical TFV gel 
No study drug significantly 
reduced the risk of HIV 
acquisition. Estimates of 
effectiveness were less 
than 0 for TDF and TDF/
FTC daily oral dosing 
(negative 48.8% and 
negative 4.2% TDF/FTC 
respectively), and reduced 
risk of HIV infection of 
14.7% for TDF gel. 
Adherence to study 
drugs was low; TFV 
was detected in 30% of 
the oral TDF arm, 29% 
in the oral TDF/FTC 
arm, and 25% in the 
TDF gel arm.
Key to Acronyms: FTC = emtricitabine; TDF = tenofovir disoproxil fumarate; TFV = tenofovir
Source: Adapted from: Kashuba et al., Pre-exposure prophylaxis for HIV prevention: how to predict success: Table Antiretroviral-based HIV
